DIAGNOSIS, from this install's own log: ComfyUI sizes its dynamic-VRAM budget from FREE memory, so the EMPTIER the card the MORE it loads. Job 7564 got 'loaded partially; 21719.11 MB usable, 21448.72 MB loaded, 1251.42 MB offloaded' (SDXL+CLIP still cached from stage 1) and died torch.OutOfMemoryError 78 MiB short at 21.32 GiB allocated on a 23.52 GiB device; the SAME workflow under ~8 GiB of co-tenants loaded '15275.11 MB usable / 7785.37 MB offloaded' and ran 'Prompt executed in 95.61 seconds'. Offloading is cheap here; over-committing is fatal. FIX (commit 6a01bb6): COMFY_LAUNCH_ARGS in bin/comfyui_harness.sh now passes --reserve-vram 5 (override COMFY_RESERVE_VRAM); it overrides EXTRA_RESERVED_VRAM (400 MiB default on Linux) AND aimdo's simple budget headroom, dropping ComfyUI's computed budget from ~21.7 GiB to ~17 GiB.
